subtopic: FOURTH SESSION-SEVENTEENTH PARLIAMENT 23-24 GEORGE V, 1933 VOLUME I, 1933 COMPRISING THE PERIOD FROM THE SIXTH DAY OF OCTOBER, 1932, TO THE FOURTEENTH DAY OF NOVEMBER, 1932, INCLUSIVE BEING VOLUME CXCIV FOR THE PERIOD 1875-1933 INDEX ISSUED IN A SEPARATE VOLUME OTTAWA J. O. PATENAUDE, ACTING KING'S PRINTER 1933 CANADA

speechtext: The parliament which had been prorogued from time to time to the 6th day of October, 1932, met this day at Ottawa, for the despatch of business.	-
